episodes.synopsis: Favaro Leone travels the land, collecting bounties while avoiding a rival bounty hunter. But his life changes when he encounters a mysterious girl from the sky…
episodes.title: Encounter Wytearp

episodes.synopsis: Favaro tries everything possible to remove his newly-acquired demon tail. Meanwhile, an elite band of knights is sent to retrieve Amira's God Key.
episodes.title: Escape From Livian

episodes.synopsis: While humans, gods, and demons pursue the God Key, Amira and Favaro venture into a small town covered in a mysterious, eerie fog...
episodes.title: Fog of Nebelville

episodes.synopsis: After receiving a helpful tip from Bacchus, Favaro and Amira finally board a boat headed for Helheim. By sheer coincidence, its captain is an old friend of Favaro's father.
episodes.title: Reunion at Ysmenport

episodes.synopsis: Favaro and Rita try to find a way into Azazel's flying castle, where Amira and Kaisar are being held prisoner.
episodes.title: Rescue in Sword Valley

episodes.synopsis: Favaro, Amira, and the others are captured and taken to the royal city of Anatae. There, truths are revealed and executions are prepared…
episodes.title: Anatae, Part 1: Legendary Saint

episodes.synopsis: Azazel, leading a demon horde, launches an assault on the human castle. His aim: Amira and the God Key.
episodes.title: Anatae, Part 2: The Storm Rages

episodes.synopsis: Azazel has been forced to retreat, and now the truth behind Amira's existence is revealed. Favaro and Kaisar are summoned to see the king, however...
episodes.title: Anatae, Part 3: Beyond the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Favaro and Amira escape from the royal capital, and all sides - gods, demons, and humans - are thrown into confusion. Meanwhile, the king of Anatae begins to act very oddly.
episodes.title: Decision in the Wailing Woods

episodes.synopsis: All hell breaks loose when Amira is finally reunited with her mother.
episodes.title: Helheim, Land of Lies

episodes.synopsis: The humans and angels struggle in a last-ditch effort to keep Amira from unlocking Bahamut's seal.
episodes.title: All Roads Lead to Abos

episodes.synopsis: Bahamut has been released, and the world is faced with destruction. How can anyone stop the power of this legendary beast?!
episodes.title: Rage of Bahamut
